name: Traditional Blues
description: Rigid 12-bar blues form with shuffle swing, a climax solo verse, and a dominant V7 turnaround outro.

defaults.concept: Traditional 12-bar blues — steady shuffle swing with I7-IV7-V7 turnaround, a swinging ride-cymbal edge pattern during the solo, resolving on a wide-voiced tonic major chord.

slots.label: The 12-Bar Verse Block
slots.purpose: FEEL: Steady shuffle swing. HARMONIC BLUEPRINT: [Bars 1-4: I7] -> [Bars 5-6: IV7] -> [Bars 7-8: I7] -> [Bar 9: V7] -> [Bar 10: IV7] -> [Bars 11-12: I7 Turnaround].

slots.label: The Climax Solo Verse
slots.purpose: FEEL: High emotional expression. PRODUCTION NOTE: Maintain the exact 12-bar chord grid sequence. Ramping up velocity prompts the drum generator to switch to an active, swinging ride-cymbal edge pattern.

slots.label: Dominant Turnaround Outro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Resolving, winding down. TRICK: Emulate a live ritardando. Vamp continuously on the dominant V7 chord block, resolving onto a final, wide-voiced tonic major chord on the last beat.
